inclusion_rule: Include every repository that passed the frozen discovery, enrichment, commit-reproducibility, license, split, and benchmark-collision gates.
required_after_fetch: apply the same content, secret, PII, generated-file, benchmark, and split gates used by the bounded smoke
run Stage 0 and Stage A independently per split
construct Stage-B selected and common disjoint Stage-A-random arms from train only
do not approve any repository or bundle for training from manifest membership alone
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: This freezes broad collection eligibility and fetch limits, not training approval or Utility.
